title: Expected value of a three-literal clause instance
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set, and let $P$ be a nonempty finite multiset of constraints on variables in $V$, each using three distinct variables and a three-literal disjunction, with each literal either the variable or its negation. Under a uniformly random assignment of Boolean values to $V$, the expected fraction of constraints satisfied, counting multiplicities, is $7/8$.
hypotheses_covered: P is a CSP instance for the three-literal disjunction template
P has at least one constraint
Every variable in V occurs in some constraint scope
